correctness.rationale: Headline claim: for rho=(5,4,3,2,1) |- 15, all 176 Kronecker numbers g(rho,rho,nu) >= 1 with exact class-sum identities S_nu = g_nu*15!. Auditor independently recomputed from committed artifacts: p(15)=176 confirmed; sum class sizes = 15! = 1307674368000; 176/176 hook-dimension matches; dim(rho)=292864 matches independent hook-formula recomputation; sum dim^2=15!; 176/176 row norms sum_C chi^2|C|=15! and 176/176 column norms sum_lam chi^2=z_mu all pass; all 176 certificates S_nu=sum_C |C| chi^rho(C)^2 chi^nu(C) equal stored g*15! and stored class_sum (0/176 fails, min 1 at (15) and (1^15), max 18269 at rho); degree identity sum_nu g_nu dim(nu)=dim(rho)^2=85769322496 passes; transpose symmetry g(nu)=g(nu^t) holds with exactly 4 self-conjugate partitions as listed; second rim-strip-walk MN implementation run by auditor reproduces full 176x176 table byte-identically (0/30976 mismatches) and prints VERIFY_OK. Computation is exact integer arithmetic (Murnaghan-Nakayama recursion), so positivity statements are machine-proved, not merely statistical evidence. Common-author caveat for the two MN programs is mitigated by four independent identities (hook dims, row/col orthogonality, degree sum) plus self-checking integer certificates re-verifiable in GAP/Sage.

originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp: Pak-Panova-Vallejo (arXiv:1304.0738) proves only hooks and two-rows in staircase squares; Ikenmeyer (arXiv:1410.6549) proves only dominance-comparable constituents, and Li shows dominance-comparability probability -> 0 so most of the n=15 row is not implied; Li (arXiv:1811.10967) proves triple-hooks (Durfee 3) with thresholds n_3=14, n_4=28, covering only the Durfee-3 slice of the n=15 row and giving no exact values or Durfee>=4 positivity; Bessenrodt-Bowman (arXiv:2202.03066) gives splitting/2-modular/Catalan theory with no complete n=15 row. Auditor fetched and confirmed these scopes via abstracts and found no source publishing the full 176-entry positivity row at n=15 with exact values (min 1, max 18269 at rho). The exact multiplicity values and full-row positivity including Durfee>=4 partitions are neither recorded nor mechanically implied by the family-wise theorems.

value.rationale: Headline result is a rigorously established exact invariant of a natural object motivated before computation: the staircase partition rho=(5,4,3,2,1) at triangular n=15 under the recognized 2012 Saxl conjecture (staircase square contains all irreps). n=15 is the next triangular case past covered range (internal memory stops at n<=12/n=10 splitting), and p(15)=176 fixes a conjecture-defined scope, not an arbitrary slice. The full certified 176-row with per-constituent class-sum certificates, extremal values (min 1, max 18269), degree identity, and transpose profile is independently retrievable as base cases for semigroup/dominance approaches and regression data for Kronecker software. This satisfies the narrow-exact-datum rule: motivated object, unknown value, precise fact a future researcher could need. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
